theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Materials (+1.65%) and Consumer Discretionary (+1.32%) led the market today, while Energy (-1.37%) and Financials (-0.34%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.76%, defensives +0.45%, and value/cyclicals +0.08% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.30% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +0.28%. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +1.10%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 1.59% to 14.90, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.82% to $4,401.30, crude oil was little changed at $77.08, and bitcoin gained 1.11% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
